shadowCrowdRadius.description: The boot soft-shadow crowd radius (world units).

renderScale.description: The scalar boot render-scale ceiling in [0.125, 1].

upscaleSharpness.description: The boot reconstruction sharpness: the spatial resolve's blend (0 bilinear .. 1 Catmull-Rom) and the strength of the sharpen a temporally resolved view gets at its rect's own extent.

temporal.description: Whether the world's own views boot reconstructing over time (world.temporal): each jitters its samples and resolves them over its history, native or reduced. Camera and session views never do.

dynamicResolution.description: Whether views boot adapting their grids (world.render-scale auto). Saved per-view quality and tier rows supply their floors. A native ceiling is lowered to three-quarter while adaptation is enabled, since a native view reconstructs nothing.

lighting.description: The scene's directional sun and ambient term. Optional, and every field within it is optional individually — an absent section, or an absent field within it, resolves to SdfFrame's pinned default for that field, so a world renders unchanged until it authors one.

lights.description: The lights, at most SdfLights.MaxLights, in slot order. At most one directional may shadow: the soft-shadow march runs once per lit pixel.

curvature.description: The stylized curvature enrichment — cavity darkening, curvature rim light, and an ink outline. Optional; absent (and all-zero) shades exactly as a world that declares none.

clock.description: The clock the section's keys read, by name in the timeline section. Required with Keys and refused without them.

keys.description: The section's keys, ascending in time. A field a key states is keyed on Clock through the keys that state it, blended by the field's type and eased by each key's ease; a field no key states keeps its authored value.

items.description: One key of Keys: a partial record of the section at one time.

at.description: Where on the section's clock the key sits, in the clock's span units, in [0, span).

ease.description: How time eases from this key to the next key that states each field. Absent is Linear.

lights.description: The lights this key moves, by name: each the same kind as the light of that name, stating only the fields it moves. A light's name and shadowing are structure, which a key never states.

curvature.description: The curvature fields this key moves.

items.title: WorldRenderLightingKey

lighting.title: WorldRenderLighting

sky.description: The procedural sky — a gradient, sun disc, star field, and distance fog. Optional; an absent section renders the default look, the two-stop gradient and fog SdfSky starts from, as data the kernels read like any authored sky.

clock.description: The clock the section's keys read, by name in the timeline section. Required with Keys and refused without them.

keys.description: The section's keys, ascending in time. A field a key states is keyed on Clock through the keys that state it; a field no key states keeps its authored value.

items.description: One key of Keys: a partial record of the sky at one time.

at.description: Where on the section's clock the key sits, in the clock's span units, in [0, span).

ease.description: How time eases from this key to the next key that states each field. Absent is Linear.

layers.description: The layers this key moves, by name: each the same kind as the layer of that name, stating only the fields it moves. A gradient states every stop the layer has, in order. Counts, seeds, a layer's name and the sun disc's light are structure, which a key never states.

items.title: WorldRenderSkyKey

sky.title: WorldRenderSky

environment.description: The analytic studio-reflection softboxes and horizon gradient a GGX specular lobe reflects. Optional; absent (no softboxes, a black horizon) contributes nothing to the shaded color.

softboxes.description: The reflection softboxes, at most SdfSky.MaxSoftboxes. Absent or empty contributes nothing.

items.description: One analytic studio-reflection softbox: a soft, angularly-extended highlight a GGX lobe catches in its mirror direction, widened by the surface's own roughness.

direction.description: From a reflecting surface toward the softbox, any nonzero length (normalized before upload).

size.description: The angular half-extent (width, height) the falloff widens by, both strictly positive.

color.description: BindableColor's grammar: the softbox's linear colour. Absent is white.

blur.description: Additional falloff softening, in the same units as Size. Absent is 0.

items.title: WorldRenderSoftbox

horizon.description: The reflection horizon gradient. Absent is black — contributes nothing.

low.description: The ground-ward (direction.y = −1) colour. Absent is black.

high.description: The sky-ward (direction.y = 1) colour. Absent is black.

horizon.title: WorldRenderHorizon

environment.title: WorldRenderEnvironment

tonemap.description: The tonemap the root graph applies to the SDF scene: each view, as its place pass reconstructs it. The letterbox color, every pane (display-referred) and the HUD are never tonemapped. Optional; absent is None — the stylized shaded color, unchanged.
tonemap.title: WorldTonemap

farDistance.description: The far distance in world units: the depth at which every camera march ends — the far plane the renderer's fine march exits at, the reach of the beam's cone proofs, and the depth the fog and depth ramps are measured against. Geometry beyond it is never marched, so an infinite plane ends on a visible horizon curve at this depth unless the sky fog has absorbed it (render.sky.fogDensity). Optional; absent resolves to the engine's pinned 40 — exactly the value every world marched to before this field existed. Must lie within [MinFarDistance, MaxFarDistance]. Re-read on every definition revision (a world.row.set render lands on the next frame); world.budget echoes it with its derived costs.
